rationale:
bugs_open/382. The image adapter's provider routing table (internal/adapters/imagegenerator/routing.go, built by bugs_open/011) decides by `kind` and flags a kind that is present but unrouted (UNROUTED_IMAGE_KIND). It deliberately EXEMPTED the absent case: an empty kind routed to Stability and reported nothing, on the stated premise that 'legacy callers that predate the field are a documented, deliberate Stability path, not an oversight'. That premise is refuted by measurement. As of 2026-08-24, 15 hero assets on 5 sites were generated by stability/stable-diffusion-xl-1024-v1-0 AFTER 011's 2026-07-18 fix (latest 2026-08-11); none of those 5 sites carries the sanctioned provider:"stability" opt-out in its imagery_style_guide (3 have no guide at all), and 0 live agent definitions pin a Stability model. The traffic through the exempt branch was neither legacy nor deliberate.

The caller-side cause is identified: `kind` reaches the action only via inputData, and for a call_agent step inputData is built SOLELY from the step config's input_mapping (extractDataForAgent). image-build-handler's call_variant_gen — the only handler of unfulfilled_hero_variant work items, i.e. every per-page hero — has no kind in its input_mapping and carries a `default_kind: "hero"` key at the step CONFIG level that is read by nothing. Migration 390 found this class on 2026-08-11, fixed call_hero_gen and call_logo_gen, and asserted in its own header that 'the Phase-2E branches (call_imagery_gen, call_variant_gen) already forward kind'. That is FALSE for call_variant_gen and still false in the live row. Proof: 390 was applied 2026-08-11 13:42 BST; five unfulfilled_hero_variant items completed on ai-agent-orchestration.com at 16:28:33/16:37:23/16:38:33/16:39:58/16:42:01 that day and the five SDXL hero assets on that site are stamped 16:28:04/16:36:53/16:38:08/16:39:30/16:41:21 — each item ~30s after the asset it made, all post-390.

This submission is the CODE half only. It fixes the mechanism rather than the instance, because the config half cannot: pageflow-builder and site-work-orchestrator each carry a generate_hero_image and a call_logo_generation step with NO kind at all, their reachability beyond a 1-day orchestration window is UNMEASURED, and any future caller can reintroduce the same shape. Changing the default closes every door at once and does not depend on a config author remembering anything — the same reasoning 011 used to replace a switch with a table, applied to the one branch 011 exempted.

SAFETY, checked rather than assumed: NewDynamicImageAdapter constructs the Banana provider unconditionally and banana.New returns an error when APIKey is empty (banana/provider.go:93-94), which aborts adapter construction. So an adapter that is RUNNING necessarily has a working Banana client; routing the absent case there cannot turn a degraded success into a failure. Blast radius on producers is enumerable: exactly ONE place in the repo publishes to system.adapter.image-generator.requests (generate_image_actions.go:502) — no Go producer bypasses it. Other consumers of the routing decision were traced in dynamic_adapter.go: provider selection is the only branch on decision.Provider; origin_model is derived from the provider's own result, aspect-ratio snapping lives inside each provider, and REFERENCE_ANCHORS_DROPPED stops firing for the absent case because Banana honours anchors (pinned by a new test so a later tidy-up cannot bring the anchor loss back).

OTHER CONSUMERS ARE BEING TOLD, not merely measured (owner ruling 2026-07-29 §3): the image-build-handler / imagery lane owns this table; the finding and this change are written into bugs_open/382 and into docs024_key_docs_latest/bugfix_382_empty_kind_routing/, and the guidance in 016b §9 that currently PRESCRIBES this exemption is being corrected with a dated block rather than edited away. The behaviour change other lanes will notice: any image request that reaches the adapter with no kind now gets Gemini/Banana instead of SDXL, and emits a MISSING_IMAGE_KIND warning row into agent_error_log.

plan.summary: bugs_open/382 — retire the empty-kind exemption in the image provider routing table: an absent `kind` now routes to Banana (the strong provider) instead of SDXL, and sets a MissingKind flag that becomes a MISSING_IMAGE_KIND record in agent_error_log so the broken caller is findable. The exemption's premise (empty kind == a deliberate legacy Stability path) was measured and refuted.

edits.rationale: Retire the empty-kind exemption. An absent kind now resolves to Banana (the strong provider) and sets a new MissingKind flag, kept SEPARATE from UnmigratedKind because the two have different fixes: map kind at the caller vs add a row to the table. Flag is set only when the table actually fell through, matching UnmigratedKind's existing semantics, so a site that set provider:"stability" is not warned about on every request.

Make the silence durable-loud: a MISSING_IMAGE_KIND condition record joins the existing three, so the chassis persists it to agent_error_log. The message names the actual remedy (map `kind` in the caller's input_mapping; a step-config `default_kind` is read by nothing) because whoever reads the row at 2am will otherwise reach for the dead key. The record carries a BOUNDED opening slice of the prompt: the row is written against the image-generator's own orchestration, whose collected_data holds nothing buildErrorContext recognises, and orchestration_states is reaped in ~1 day, so 'walk up to the parent' stops working overnight — the prompt opening is stable per producer and needs no join.

Symmetry with the existing UnmigratedKind and BadHint warns, and pass the prompt through to reportedConditions. The log line is the live-tailing half; the condition record is the durable half. 016b §9 requires the log line to name the value and the valid set, so it carries routed_kinds.

TestRouteProviderEmptyKindIsLegacyNotUnmigrated asserted the defect and had to be REPLACED, not extended — it was a faithful test of a premise that turned out false, and leaving it would have made this bug unfixable without an argument. The replacement quotes the old assertion in a comment with the measurement that refuted it, so the inversion is legible rather than looking like a weakened test. New coverage: absent kind -> banana + MissingKind and NOT UnmigratedKind; whitespace-only kind is absence, not an unrouted kind; explicit provider:"stability" still wins on an absent kind (the escape hatch the fix leans on); a bad hint with no kind reports BOTH defects; the condition's prompt_opening is present and bounded with a visible ellipsis; REFERENCE_ANCHORS_DROPPED no longer fires for an absent kind. Both new guards were MUTATION-tested: routing the absent case back to Stability fails 2 tests, and dropping the flag fails 4 — different tests, so neither passes via a guard in series.

grounded_in: routing.go (pre-change): "An EMPTY kind does not set this: legacy callers that predate the field are a documented, deliberate Stability path, not an oversight."

390_forward_kind_on_legacy_image_branches.sql: "Blast radius: the two legacy branches only. The Phase-2E branches (call_imagery_gen, call_variant_gen) already forward kind." — FALSE for call_variant_gen; its live input_mapping is {"prompt": "input_data.spec.prompt", "site_plan": "input_data.spec"} with config default_kind "hero".
390 header, same class, already correct: "a static config value for a field the spec was meant to supply is DEAD. `default_kind` here has never done anything."
call_agent.go extractDataForAgent: PRIORITY 1 resolves input_mapping and returns; no branch carries other step-config keys into the callee's input_data.

banana/provider.go:93-94: `if cfg.APIKey == "" { return nil, errors.New("banana provider: APIKey required") }`, and dynamic_adapter.go aborts construction on that error — so a running adapter always has Banana.

Live census 2026-08-24: SELECT s.domain, a.asset_key, a.created_at FROM assets a JOIN sites s ON s.id=a.site_id WHERE a.origin_model='stability/stable-diffusion-xl-1024-v1-0' AND a.created_at>'2026-07-18' -> 15 rows, 14 of them per-page hero_<page> keys, latest 2026-08-11.

Live census 2026-08-24: 0 rows in agent_error_log for UNROUTED_IMAGE_KIND / UNRECOGNISED_PROVIDER_HINT / REFERENCE_ANCHORS_DROPPED over a 31-day retained window (46,379 rows total), i.e. the exempt branch has produced no evidence of itself by design.
conditionReportingAgentTypes = {"image-generator": true} and the adapter sets Headers.Sender.AgentType = "image-generator", so the new condition is on a sanctioned channel and will persist.
Only publisher to system.adapter.image-generator.requests in the repo: generate_image_actions.go:502.
plan.risks: 1) COST/BEHAVIOUR: any caller still omitting kind moves from SDXL to Gemini/Banana. That is the intended direction (every declared kind is already on Banana) but it is a real per-image cost and style change for those callers, and it lands the moment the adapter rolls. Measured surface: the only live producer of empty-kind requests today is image-build-handler's call_variant_gen (per-page heroes); pageflow-builder and site-work-orchestrator carry the same shape but show no runs in the 1-day orchestration window and their reachability beyond that is UNMEASURED. 2) A site that genuinely wants SDXL and has no kind must set provider:"stability" — the hint path is untouched and pinned by a new test, and no site on the fleet currently sets it, so nothing loses a choice it had made. 3) The new condition is written against the image-generator's own orchestration, so site_id/domain/work_item_id on the row will be NULL for callers that also omit site_id (call_variant_gen omits both). The bounded prompt_opening in the context is the mitigation, and the config half of this bug (a separate migration, not in this submission) adds site_id to that step. Flagged rather than fixed here because widening the chassis's buildErrorEntry to fall back to input_data.site_id would change a shared helper used by every agent_error_log row, which is a different review. 4) This does NOT fix the callers — a config migration for call_variant_gen ships alongside; the code change is what makes the class safe rather than the instance.
